items.requirement: Clean checkout migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and starts API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI using only published commands.
OpenAPI, validation, identity state, and responses agree with the contract while credentials, tokens, assertions, nonces, and private keys never leak.
One successful login creates one Session; refresh is single-use and prior-token reuse revokes the complete family atomically.
Device trust is bound to one user, fingerprint, nonce, and expiry; replay, cross-user use, and concurrent revoke cannot restore trust.
Key rotation has one ACTIVE issuer, bounded verification overlap, durable retirement, and monotonic revocation fencing across processes.
Every security transition commits one secret-free immutable AuditEntry whose tenant sequence and digest chain detect mutation or deletion.
Manager compromise quarantine and recovery use captured approval policy, revoke old identity state once, and never revive prior credentials or keys.
All three fixed sustained scenarios meet throughput, latency, propagation, recovery, chain, and secret-boundary requirements.
The repository owns meaningful unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, security invariant, and performance commands.
Codex explains trust boundaries, state, propagation, cryptographic lifecycle, recovery, and review findings clearly.
Every stage and final handoff reports actual commands, results, risks, and checks not run accurately.
